title: The New Stew
note: b384 — first use of 'stew_pot', 'steam', 'spoon', 'pea', 'bowl'. The big cup on p6 reuses `teacup` scaled up via its own o.w, not a new prop.

pages.brief: Nell the bee beside a brand new cooking pot, gleaming and far too big for her, admiring her reflection in it. Bright and proud.
pages.alt: Nell the bee stands beside a brand new cooking pot, gleaming and far too big for her, admiring her own reflection in it.

pages.brief: Nell perched on the pot's rim stirring with a long twig, steam rising past her. Warm kitchen-ish light, rich browns.
pages.alt: Nell is perched on the pot's rim, stirring with a long twig as steam rises past her in warm kitchen-ish light.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar blowing hard across a spoonful of stew, cheeks out, steam bending away from him. Comic effort.
pages.alt: Fig blows hard across a spoonful of stew, cheeks out, with the steam bending away from him in comic effort.

pages.brief: Fig recoiling with his mouth open and tongue out, one leg fanning his face. The stew clearly far too hot.
pages.alt: Fig recoils with his mouth open and tongue out — the stew is clearly far too hot.

pages.brief: Close on the surface of the stew with exactly a few round green peas floating in it, drawn countably. Rich and appetising.
pages.alt: A close view of the stew's surface with exactly a few round green peas floating in it, drawn countably. Rich and appetising.

pages.brief: Nell with an enormous cup, drinking with both front legs round it, almost disappearing behind it. Funny scale.
pages.alt: Nell has an enormous cup, drinking with both front legs round it, almost disappearing behind it. Funny scale.

pages.brief: Both of them sitting on the pot rim with full bowls, eyes shut in appreciation. Warm and companionable.
pages.alt: Both of them sit on the pot rim with full bowls, eyes shut in appreciation — warm and companionable.

pages.brief: Closing page: the pot scraped completely clean and gleaming, two very round friends asleep against it. Cosy evening light.
pages.alt: Closing page: the pot is scraped completely clean and gleaming, two very round friends asleep against it in cosy evening light.
